text.en: Rules may be cited as the National Retirement Scheme Rules, 2023 and shall commence on the same date as the National Retirement Scheme Order,

In these Rules, unless the context otherwise requires - bank" means a bank which has been approved by the Board to contribution payments for the purposes of rule 18; computer programme" means a computer programme which has been designed or approved by the Board.

PART2

OF EMPLOYERS

(1) Every employer shall, before the end of the first week in the first in which he is paying wages in respect of which he is required to pay under the Order or regulations made thereunder, register with the by submitting to the Board in such form and manner as the Board may

(2) Any employer who contravenes subrule (1) is guilty of an offence.

(3) Where any person ceases to be an employer, he shall, within 30 days of such cesser, notify the Board of the same in writing.

(4) Any person who contravenes subrule (3) is guilty of an offence.
An employer may register with the Board for - fa} different categories of employees; and {b} different locations of his company. Particulars required

(1) An employer who is required to register under rule 3 shall give the as required and may be required to produce such documentary as the Board considers necessary to support the accuracy of any such

(2) Every employer shall notify the Board in writing of any change of such as required under subrule ( 1) not later than 30 days after any such change in particulars.

(3) Any employer who contravenes subrule (2) is guilty of an offence.

PART3 Registration of employees

( 1) Every employer shall not later than the 7th day of the month following the month referred to in rule 3(1) register with the Board all his employees for whom contributions are required.

(2) An employer who fails to register any employee with the Board as by subrule (1) is guilty of an offence.
An application for registration shall be made in such form and manner as the Board may determine. Registration card

A member whose registration has been accepted by the Board shall be given a registration card in such form and manner as the Board may determine he shall produce whenever he requires any service provided by the Board. Two registrations

PARTS

VOLUNTARY CONTRIBUTIONS Voluntary contribution

A member is allowed to make voluntary contributions at any time every subject to a maximum amount as the Board may determine.

PART6

OF CONTRIBUTIONS

(1) All payments of contributions shall be madefa} by submitting forms as the Board may determine; or fb} using an approved computer programme with forms as the Board may determine, together with the payments.

(2) Payment may be made - fa} in cash payable to the Managing Director; fb} by crossed cheque, postal order or money order payable to the Managing Director; fc} by any electronic means as the Board may permit, subject to such the Board may impose in connection with the use of such or fd} in such other manner as the Board may authorise in any particular case or class of cases.

(3) Any person paying by cheque, postal order or money order shall write his account number at the back of such cheque, postal order or money order. Payment received under section 11
of contributions under section 11 for each preceding month shall be submitted not later than the 15th day of the following month.
of contributions for each preceding month sent through the post be postmarked not later than the 15th day of the following month. Payment through bank
of contributions for each preceding month paid through an bank shall be received by the bank not later than the 15th day of the month. Offences under this Part
An employer who fails to pay to the Board within the period mentioned in 16, 17 and 18 which he is liable to pay is guilty of an offence.

(1) Where an employee is employed by two or more employers and payment from all employers, these employers shall be liable to pay and the employee shall be required to pay contributions for all received from these employers.

(2) Notwithstanding subrule (1), if an employee is employed by two or more but is only receiving one wage, he shall be required to pay from that wage only. Register of contributions payment

(1) Every employer shall prepare and furnish statement of wages to each and every employee and the statement of wages shall contain payment and such as the Board may determine.

(2) Every employer shall prepare and keep one or more registers the following particulars of every employee - fa} full name of employee; fb} membership number; {c) gender; {d) date of birth;

(e) identity card and colour; ((} permanent home address;

(g) occupation; (h} date of commencement of employment; {i} duration of wage period; UJ wages for the period; {k} bonuses paid by the employer for the period; {l} other remuneration for the period; {m} amount deducted from contributions; and {n} amount paid by employer for employer's share of contributions, and such register shall be kept for such period that every particular recorded shall be available for inspection for not less than 6 years after the recording thereof.

(3) The register required to be kept under subrule (2) shall be prima facie of such entry having been made.

PART7

PAYMENT FROM SCHEME
All applications for payments under the Order shall be made in such form and manner as the Board may determine. Forms etc. sent or made available in electronic form

Documents required

A member who is applying for any form of payment shall give the as required and may be required to produce such documentary as the Board may consider necessary to support the accuracy of any such particulars. of payments

(1) All payments approved under the Order shall be collected by the who applied for the payment or in any other manner as the Board may

(2) No collections are allowed by anyone other than the member himself, the payments made are received under section 20(1){a}, (c} or (d).

(3) Notwithstanding subrule (1), a member may apply to the Board for to be paid to his own bank account or posted to him at his address and the Board shall not be held responsible for any loss or non-receipt of such

PARTS Fees for services

The fee on an application for information under section 32(3) is $50 for member for which a prospective employer is seeking information. Made this 4th. day of Zulkaedah, 1444 Hijriah corresponding to the 24th. day of May, 2023. DATO SERI SETIA DR. AWANG HAJI MOHD AMIN LIEW BIN ABDULLAH Tabung Amanah Pekerja Board.
